algorithm.Title: Pregnancy - Urination Pain - Female (Adult)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Adult | Female
Definition: UAT-only assessment of painful urination or suspected urinary infection in a confirmed current pregnancy; not approved for real-patient or production use.

Background.ExpertReviewer: Pending qualified Qatar adult and adolescent obstetric and safeguarding review

FirstAid: For a life-threatening emergency, call Qatar 999. Otherwise go immediately to the emergency department at the patient's booked HMC maternity hospital or the Qatar maternity destination approved for this UAT environment. Do not drive if faint, confused, severely unwell, or bleeding heavily. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.

questions.Question: Is pain in the side or back the main concern rather than pain primarily during urination?
questions.Information: Pain focused in the side or back belongs in the Flank Pain pathway.

questions.Question: Along with urinary symptoms, is the patient confused, difficult to wake, severely short of breath, fainting or collapsing, unable to keep fluids down and rapidly worsening, having regular contractions or fluid loss, bleeding heavily, or reporting reduced or changed fetal movement?
questions.Information: Sepsis red flags or signs of preterm labor in a pregnant person with a possible urinary tract infection require immediate emergency care.

questions.Question: In this confirmed pregnancy, is there painful or frequent urination, urgency, blood in the urine, fever or chills, or back or flank pain without the emergency features above?
questions.Information: NHS.UK cystitis guidance lists pregnancy itself as an automatic urgent-review criterion, since untreated UTIs in pregnancy carry a higher risk of kidney infection and preterm labor.

advice.Title: Emergency pregnancy urinary symptom precautions
Content: For a life-threatening emergency, call Qatar 999. Otherwise go immediately to the emergency department at the patient's booked HMC maternity hospital or the Qatar maternity destination approved for this UAT environment. Do not drive if faint, confused, severely unwell, or bleeding heavily. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: worsening contractions or fluid loss; heavier bleeding; confusion, collapse, or breathing difficulty.

advice.Title: Same-day pregnancy urinary assessment
Content: Arrange same-day in-person maternity or obstetric assessment through the patient's booked service or the Qatar pathway approved for this UAT environment. A urine test and clinical assessment may be required. Do not use leftover antibiotics or start an antibiotic, urinary remedy, or pain medicine unless a maternity clinician or pharmacist confirms it is appropriate in this pregnancy.
Call Back If: fever or vomiting develops; back or flank pain worsens; contractions, bleeding, fluid loss, or changed fetal movement develops.

references: NHS.UK, "Cystitis", https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/cystitis/ (page last reviewed 11 July 2025) - pregnancy-specific urgent-review criterion
World Health Organization, "Assessing and supporting adolescents' capacity for autonomous decision-making in health care settings", 2021
